description: Get a Korean Tax Tribunal decision: order (주문), claim (청구취지), summary (재결요지), related laws, referenced decisions and reasons. Decisions are not law but rulings on individual cases, and may change later. id is the number from search_tax_tribunal results (not the claim number).

id.description: The first number (digits) of a search_tax_tribunal result. Not the claim number (e.g. 조심 2020부1558)

name: get_tax_tribunal
title: Get Tax Tribunal decision (조세심판원 결정 보기)
